_: Pre-registered work for tools/watch.py. A person writes these; the loop only runs them.
That split is the design, not a limitation: [T-065] found every narrowing in this
project came from choosing WHICH held-fixed dimension to vary, which is judgement.
An agent that picked its own next experiment would be guessing at the one step that
ticket  : the E- id, so the report can read the pre-stated outcomes back out
runner  : path relative to the repo root
model   : for the preflight smoke test
expect  : verdicts that are EXPECTED. Anything else stops the queue and escalates.

jobs._why: Every verdict here is a surprise worth waking for. MECHANICAL would be the project's one outward-facing result; NOT MECHANICAL would close that claim honestly and is the more useful outcome; UNDIFFERENTIATED would say the measure cannot speak to their taxonomy. `expect` is deliberately empty — the right setting for a first run of anything.
